Max errors: mark pixels 2 (0 in 5 of the 14 state cells, 1 in 6; marks are the blend of two baked tables per window context at the control's y, the theme bitmap being resampled with a phase that follows y), focus rectangle top, bottom and right lines 2 (analytic dotted model: dots 1 on 1 off, window scale 1.0007 on the Options pages, the right line's dots continuing round the corner by the span's parity), mnemonic underline 1, flat structure 0 px off in all 17 cells, text word edges within 1 px. 1.5x renders on whole device pixels (winpx).
